yard.definition: A yard is the area around a house.
yard.sentence: The children went out to play in the yard.

yeah.sentence: Yeah, sure, I'll go with you to the store.

year.definition: A measure of the time taken for the earth to circle the sun - any 12 month period.

yellow.definition: One of the colors people can see.

yes.definition: A word that is used to agree or accept; to mean the same thing that the other person said.

yet.definition: When something hasn't happened yet, it didn't happen, but it might happen in the future.

yield.definition: A yield is how much of a crop is grown in a year.
yield.sentence: This year's harvest had a good yield.

young.definition: If you are young, you have not lived a long time.
young.sentence: She was only a young girl.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.
